scripts.dev: node scripts/generate-builtin-skill-markdown.mjs && node scripts/generate-studio-content.mjs && npm run generate:plugin-release && node esbuild.config.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-builtin-skill-markdown.mjs && node scripts/generate-studio-content.mjs && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && npm run generate:plugin-release
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-builtin-skill-markdown.mjs && node scripts/generate-studio-content.mjs && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node --test tests/*.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
